statement: For positive natural o,L with 2^L<3^o, define multiplier=3^o/2^L and dualDegree=3^o/(3^o-2^L) in the rationals. dualDegree=multiplier/(multiplier-1). A natural d equals dualDegree exactly when 3^o=d*(3^o-2^L). Such d exists exactly when 3^o=2^L+1, whose only positive solutions are (o,L)=(1,1),(2,3), giving d=3,9 respectively. Thus there is no natural dual degree for L>3. The rational minus-Collatz pullbackWord fixed-point equation has this same gap: (3^oddCount(w)-2^length(w))*q=wordConst(w). For nonzero real h and real r, h/2*(8*r/(9*h))^9-r*((8*r/(9*h))^8-1)/2 equals ninthPhase(h,r)=r/2-2^23*r^9/(3^18*h^8). For odd natural h, wave(ninthPhase(h,r)) changes sign under r -> r+3^18*h^8 on natural r and its complete sum of 2*3^18*h^8 terms is zero. All these arithmetic and algebra statements are kernel-checked; advisory statement coverage remains pending. This does not assert differentiation of general real powers, an incomplete or parity-selected exponential-sum estimate, or an obstruction to every iteration of the perturbed cubic method.
